notes: §1985:XIII.3.16.2 prints 'NEXT GROUP IS { integer-1 | PLUS integer-2 | NEXT PAGE }' with no phrase after NEXT PAGE. reportNextGroupClause parses the 2023 superset 'NEXT PAGE [WITH] RESET', VisitReportRelativeSign refuses the '+' symbol at 85 (COBOL0900, ReportPlusSymbol2002), and BindNextGroupClauses binds the clause and records the RESET flag (ngc.RESET()), but no 85 arm refuses the RESET phrase, so 'NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE WITH RESET' and '... NEXT PAGE RESET' compile at 85 and reset PAGE-COUNTER. The other arms conform: probes at 85 accepted NEXT GROUP [IS] 5 (next detail at line 6), IS PLUS 2 (line 4), [IS] NEXT PAGE (form feed); refused '+ 2' COBOL0900, 'IS PAGE' (the witness) / empty / -5 / PLUS -2 COBOL0001, '5 6' COBOL0307, written twice COBOL2423, 0 and PLUS 0 COBOL2386, WS-C COBOL1547, absolute NEXT GROUP in an unpaged report COBOL2284. Seen beside it, already filed: NEXT GROUP PLUS 1000 in an unpaged report is accepted although §1985:XIII.3.16.3 SR2 allows three digits (PB5079). kb/Work PB5242 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-pipe/slice-49.json).

next.reason: 1985: 'NEXT GROUP IS {integer-1 | PLUS integer-2 | NEXT PAGE}'. §2023:13.18.37.2 keeps the three alternatives with the same meaning but adds '+' as a synonym of PLUS (§2023:13.18.37.3 SR2 'PLUS and + are synonyms') and an optional 'WITH RESET' after NEXT PAGE. More clauses accepted. CHANGED (looser).
